decisions.title: Domain-first runtime
decisions.decision: Own collaboration semantics; integrate generic infrastructure.
decisions.rationale: The product must preserve collaboration identity and evidence across replaceable Harnesses and machines.
decisions.scope: Collaboration Core and all exposed command/query surfaces.
decisions.consequences: The system implements deterministic collaboration contracts while external Harness Agents retain intelligence and execution.
decisions.migration_impact: Introduce Runtime domain projections without changing existing setup-only Skill semantics.
decisions.validation_required: Boundary static review, domain transition tests and external-principal provenance checks.
decisions.boundary: External Harness Agents own reasoning, planning, delegation and execution; the Collaboration Core owns durable collaboration semantics and accepts only authenticated external-principal commands.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Revisit only if a mature compatible domain runtime replaces the entire bounded subdomain.

decisions.title: Shared application core
decisions.decision: MCP, CLI and HTTP share schemas, authorization and state transitions.
decisions.rationale: Multiple entry points must produce one durable project truth.
decisions.scope: MCP, CLI, HTTP/RPC and future UI adapters.
decisions.consequences: Surface adapters remain thin and cannot create alternate business state machines.
decisions.migration_impact: Map existing manual/file entry points to versioned commands where adopted.
decisions.validation_required: Surface parity tests with identical command, revision and authorization outcomes.
decisions.boundary: A2A is an external-agent gateway; ACP/native APIs are runtime edges.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Extend surfaces without forking domain semantics.

decisions.title: Durable engine
decisions.decision: Temporal is the first reference provider.
decisions.rationale: Long waits, retries and submitted-operation recovery need durable infrastructure with explicit history.
decisions.scope: Provider execution of already committed commands, delivery, lease, effect and reconciliation operations.
decisions.consequences: Provider workers and timers are infrastructure processes; they do not perform Agent reasoning.
decisions.migration_impact: Add provider adapter and operation IDs without making provider workflow IDs product identities.
decisions.validation_required: Provider restart, timer, retry, outbox and reconciliation conformance on the named profile.
decisions.boundary: Temporal is a Durable Operation Provider for submitted command, delivery, lease, effect and reconciliation operations. DBOS and Restate remain provider alternatives. No Agent Graph, Planner, Supervisor Agent, LLM orchestration or internal Management Agent is a Collaboration System component.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Reconsider against measured local footprint, deployment constraints and full recovery conformance.

decisions.title: Single authoritative domain writer
decisions.rationale: One transactional authority is required for CAS, events, inbox/outbox and accepted-state integrity.
decisions.scope: Task, Lease, AcceptedState, Approval, Message, Inbox, Outbox and domain events.
decisions.consequences: Node journals and provider histories are projections or operation records, not competing authorities.
decisions.migration_impact: Import legacy facts with provenance and cut over one authority at a time.
decisions.validation_required: Crash-after-commit, duplicate command, stale revision and reconciliation tests.
decisions.boundary: Workflow history and Node journals do not form independent competing domain authorities.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Federate by explicit subdomain authority, not offline multi-master writes.

decisions.title: Stable collaborator identity
decisions.decision: AgentSlot and directed CommunicationBinding outlive Runtime/Session bindings.
decisions.rationale: Long-lived external Agent roles must survive Harness, Session, Machine and Endpoint replacement.
decisions.scope: Root/Route/Engineer Source Scope, AgentSlot, Runtime and HarnessSessionBinding.
decisions.consequences: Provider session IDs remain references; Scope identity and durable knowledge remain stable.
decisions.migration_impact: Add Scope/ScopeBinding projections and attach historical sessions as replaceable bindings.
decisions.validation_required: Rebinding tests across Harness, Session and Machine changes with identity preservation.
decisions.boundary: Route is a long-lived development goal, not a transport-routing entry.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Preserve existing Root and Route identifiers.

decisions.title: Dynamic transport recovery
decisions.decision: System-managed E2E is desired policy; Human Bridge is a temporary incident.
decisions.rationale: Agent communication should recover through verified system paths while retaining a bounded recovery escape.
decisions.scope: Directed Message delivery, capability probes, provider selection and Human Bridge incidents.
decisions.consequences: Provider switching preserves message identity; unavailable external Agents remain pending/blocked.
decisions.migration_impact: Interpret legacy user relay as historical observation and resolve current bindings dynamically.
decisions.validation_required: Asymmetric paths, ACK loss, capability expiry, recovery exhaustion and automatic re-probe tests.
decisions.boundary: Provider switching preserves logical message identity.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Re-probe on new facts, changed versions, permissions, endpoints and connectivity.

decisions.title: Fencing and effect safety
decisions.decision: Lease renewal and admission are transactional; protected effects enforce fencing.
decisions.rationale: TTL alone cannot prevent a partitioned old external Agent Runtime from writing.
decisions.scope: Workspaces, branches, devices, databases, quotas and external effect gateways.
decisions.consequences: Unfenceable resources become blocked until isolated or old ownership is confirmed terminated.
decisions.migration_impact: Existing resource handling gains generation, authority incarnation and fencing metadata.
decisions.validation_required: Old-owner revival, token expiry, revoke and protected-effect rejection tests.
decisions.boundary: Unfenceable shared resources require isolation or confirmed old external Agent Runtime termination.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Do not downgrade safety to availability without an explicit bounded policy.

decisions.title: Evidence-based acceptance
decisions.decision: Task accepted requires integrated baseline evidence and final read-back.
decisions.rationale: External Agent reports and transport acknowledgements do not prove the engineering result.
decisions.scope: Candidate, verification, finalization, publication and AcceptedState transitions.
decisions.consequences: Review and acceptance commands remain external Agent decisions; Core enforces evidence gates.
decisions.migration_impact: Legacy completion records import as candidate or unverified evidence until read-back.
decisions.validation_required: Integrated baseline, stale evidence, external mutation and final read-back scenarios.
decisions.boundary: External Agent success, provider-process completion, broker ACK and model narration are not acceptance.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Risk-based review policies remain versioned and auditable.

decisions.title: Data minimization and deployment profiles
decisions.decision: Support local, hybrid, managed and self-hosted profiles with explicit authority.
decisions.rationale: Different users require distinct data residency, control and deployment boundaries.
decisions.scope: Control metadata, messages, source, artifacts, credentials and external Harness payloads.
decisions.consequences: No profile silently uploads source or changes authority; hosted support is policy-scoped.
decisions.migration_impact: Profile adoption is explicit and preserves local source and identity facts.
decisions.validation_required: Data-flow, residency, credential, export and profile-specific E2E checks.
decisions.boundary: Payload E2EE removes plaintext cloud analysis unless an explicitly authorized external Agent Runtime in a trusted boundary can decrypt it.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Any source/data residency change is a policy migration.

decisions.title: Non-destructive migration
decisions.decision: Preserve identities, AGENTS user content and knowledge; import provenance.
decisions.rationale: Existing Root/Route identity and user-owned knowledge are durable product facts.
decisions.scope: Root, Route, Scope, AGENTS.md, .agents/knowledge, source and Git history.
decisions.consequences: Migration is additive, auditable and reversible; it does not enable autonomous execution.
decisions.migration_impact: Inventory, dry-run, import, authority cutover, export and rollback are required.
decisions.validation_required: Digest comparison, interrupted migration, repeat convergence and rollback tests.
decisions.boundary: Schema upgrade does not silently enable autonomous execution or source upload.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Cut over one authority and export before rollback.

decisions.title: Capability truth
decisions.decision: Documentation seeds discovery; runtime confirmations are scoped and expiring.
decisions.rationale: A Harness or protocol description cannot prove a particular endpoint is usable under current policy.
decisions.scope: Machine, Node, Harness, Runtime, Session, direction, credentials and transport observations.
decisions.consequences: Unknown remains unknown after expiry; product support requires five-layer evidence.
decisions.migration_impact: Legacy capability labels become scoped observations with provenance and expiry.
decisions.validation_required: Probe, expiry, revocation, version change and cross-machine capability tests.
decisions.boundary: Product supported requires the existing five-layer evidence formula.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Revalidate per Harness, version, OS, scope and topology.

decisions.title: Billing as an integration boundary
decisions.decision: Own usage and budget ledger; integrate payment and subscription infrastructure.
decisions.rationale: Usage truth and budget admission belong to collaboration policy while payment rails are specialized infrastructure.
decisions.scope: Raw, estimated, reconciled and unknown usage; reservations, quotas and billing adapters.
decisions.consequences: Unknown usage is visible and never treated as zero; billing failure does not erase collaboration facts.
decisions.migration_impact: Legacy usage imports retain source and confidence; payment integration is added later by profile.
decisions.validation_required: Duplicate events, delayed provider usage, budget admission and reconciliation tests.
decisions.boundary: Raw usage, estimated cost, reconciled cost and billing state are distinct.
decisions.reconsideration_condition: Unknown usage is never silently counted as zero.
